name: Fountain Hills
seo_title: Fountain Hills Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Fountain Hills, AZ: Stroll in the Glow, Breakfast with Santa, Sensitive Santa and A Christmas Carol at Fountain Hills Theater.
lede: Fountain Hills celebrates Christmas with a Chamber of Commerce lighting stroll on the Avenue of the Fountains, Santa visits at the Community Center and a family holiday musical at its own theater.
celebrates: The Fountain Hills Chamber of Commerce leads the season with Stroll in the Glow, when thousands of lights come on along the Avenue of the Fountains, including the official Town of Fountain Hills Christmas tree. Santa arrives on a big red fire truck for free photos, and hot air balloons glow over Fountain Park. The town's Parks and Recreation department holds Breakfast with Santa and a free Sensitive Santa hour for families with autistic children and children with special needs at the Community Center. Fountain Hills Theater adds A Christmas Carol The Musical, its family holiday show, in the Noel Irick and Peter J. Hill Playhouse.
lastyear: Stroll in the Glow was held on Saturday, December 6, 2025, and the tourism office described it as a free and cherished holiday tradition that welcomes people of all ages from all over. The Chamber's 2026 listing calls the lighting of the Avenue around 5:45 pm and Santa's fire truck arrival traditional parts of the evening. The 2026 edition is billed by the Chamber of Commerce as the 37th annual Stroll in the Glow.
facts: The fountain at the center of town reaches 560 feet at full height, which the tourism site says is higher than the Washington Monument and three times as high as Old Faithful. It was built in 1970 by Robert McCulloch, the year the master planned community was established. The community was designed by Charles Wood Jr., the designer of Disneyland in southern California. The fountain sprays for about fifteen minutes at the top of each hour from a concrete water lily sculpture in the center of a large man-made lake.
trains: Our research did not find a train ride inside Fountain Hills this season, so train families head to nearby towns. McCormick-Stillman Railroad Park in Scottsdale runs Holiday Lights with train rides in the evening, from 5:30 to 9:30 pm on its host calendar, and has its own card on our Scottsdale guide. The Arizona Railway Museum in Chandler is a railway museum with its own listing on our museums guide. Check each host for current ride days and prices before you drive.
train_links: Railroad park in Scottsdale with a Holiday Lights train ride in the evenings.
A railway museum in Chandler, listed on our museums guide.
traditions: The Chamber of Commerce lights the Avenue of the Fountains and the official Town of Fountain Hills Christmas tree in an evening of lights, Santa and music.
Santa arrives on a big red fire truck at Stroll in the Glow for free photos provided by the Chamber of Commerce.
Hot air balloons glow in the sky over Fountain Park during Stroll in the Glow, a community favorite.
The town's Community Center serves a registered breakfast with cookies, crafts and a picture with Santa.
A calmer, sensory-friendly Santa visit for families with autistic children and children with special needs, free and open to the public.
Fountain Hills Theater stages A Christmas Carol The Musical, rated G, in its Playhouse each December.
kidfact: Fountain Hills has a fountain that shoots water 560 feet into the sky, higher than the Washington Monument, and it sprays for about fifteen minutes at the top of every hour.
faq: What is Stroll in the Glow in Fountain Hills?

Stroll in the Glow is the Fountain Hills Chamber of Commerce's holiday lighting evening on the Avenue of the Fountains. It features the lighting of the Avenue and the official town Christmas tree, Santa arriving on a fire truck for free photos, and a Balloon Glow at Fountain Park. The tourism listing tags it as a free event.
Can kids meet Santa for free in Fountain Hills?

Yes. The Chamber of Commerce provides free photos with Santa at Stroll in the Glow, and the town's Sensitive Santa hour at the Community Center is free and open to the public. The town's Breakfast with Santa is a separate registered event that costs $15 per person, so check each listing on this page.
Is there a Santa visit for children with special needs in Fountain Hills?

Yes. The town's Sensitive Santa is a calmer, sensory-friendly event for families with autistic children and children with special needs, of all ages. Families meet Santa, take photos, make crafts and enjoy snacks at a comfortable pace. It is free and open to the public, and the town directs questions to its recreation page.
How tall is the Fountain Hills fountain?

At full height the fountain reaches 560 feet, which the Experience Fountain Hills tourism site says is higher than the Washington Monument. It was built in 1970 and sprays for about fifteen minutes at the top of each hour. The fountain is extended to its full height on special occasions, so families can watch from Fountain Park.
Is there a Christmas show for kids in Fountain Hills?

Fountain Hills Theater stages A Christmas Carol The Musical, which it calls its family holiday musical and rates G. The show has two acts and runs about two hours in the Noel Irick and Peter J. Hill Playhouse. The theater does not print a ticket price on its page, so check its box office for current prices.
Is there a train ride in Fountain Hills?

We did not find a train ride in Fountain Hills itself this season. Families usually drive to McCormick-Stillman Railroad Park in Scottsdale, which has Holiday Lights with train rides in the evening, or visit the Arizona Railway Museum in Chandler. Check each host for current days and prices, since schedules and ticket rules can change.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Fountain Hills for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Breakfast with Santa and Sensitive Santa at the Community Center) through December 20, with Stroll in the Glow on the Avenue of the Fountains (December 5) and A Christmas Carol The Musical at Fountain Hills Theater (December 4 to 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Fountain Hills

  • Meet Santa: Breakfast with Santa (November 28), Sensitive Santa (November 28) and free photos with Santa at Stroll in the Glow (December 5)
  • Tree lighting and lights: Stroll in the Glow lights the Avenue of the Fountains and the town Christmas tree, with a Balloon Glow at Fountain Park
  • Also new: A Christmas Carol The Musical at Fountain Hills Theater (December 4 to 20)
  • Season: November 28 to December 20
